description: Create a new map: writes MapXXX.json and registers it in MapInfos.json. The map starts empty unless `fill` is given (a ground tile for layer 0); afterwards use paint_tiles to paint it, get_tileset_info to choose tiles and add events with the event tools. Returns the new map id.

index.description: Tile index, for sheets A5 (0-127) and B-E (0-255)

kind.description: Autotile kind, for sheets A1-A4 (A1 0-15, A2 16-47, A3 48-79, A4 80-127)

fill.description: Optional tile to fill layer 0 with, e.g. {sheet:'A2', kind:16} for grass

parentId.description: Parent map id in the editor tree (0 = top level)

name: create_map
title: Create map
